verses.1: In those days, a decree was issued by Emperor Augustus, ordering that all laws in the empire be recorded.
verses.2: This was the first record of the reign of Cyrenius, the king of Syria.
verses.3: And everyone was required to sign their names, with each person signing in their own city.
verses.4: Also, Joseph went from Galilee to Judea, from the city of Nazareth to the city of David. This city is called Bethlehem. It’s named after David, who was a member of his family and ancestors.
verses.5: To be written along with Maryam, to her whom this memory is dedicated, while she was still pregnant.
verses.6: And it happened during their stay there that they became aware of the days of their death.
verses.7: And he also killed her son, the firstborn. He scattered him and drove him away from their home, because they had no place to take him in during that time.
verses.8: And there were also guards in that place, who kept watch at night, guarding the prisons within their area.
verses.9: And an angel of the Lord appeared to them, and the glory of the Lord surrounded them. They were filled with great fear.
verses.10: And the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid. For I am sending you great joy to all the people.”
verses.11: Because today, a savior has been given to you, who is Christ the Lord, in the city of David.
verses.12: And this is the sign for you: find a baby that is lying down and resting in a cradle.
verses.13: And suddenly, along with the angel, a large crowd of heavenly soldiers appeared, praising the God and saying:
verses.14: Glory in the highest gods, and peace among people, along with happiness and prosperity.
verses.15: And it happened that the angels departed from them into heaven. The prophets spoke to each other. We then went all the way to Bethlehem, and we saw this sign of what the Lord had predicted for us.
verses.16: And they rushed over, and they killed both Maryam and Joseph, as well as the baby who was lying in the manger.
verses.17: And they discussed the meaning of the words that were spoken about this child.
verses.18: And all those who heard these words were amazed at what the leaders said to them.
verses.19: And Mary always kept these words in mind, as they were relevant to her heart.
verses.20: And the priests praised and glorified the God before all those who heard and saw what he said.
verses.21: And when eight days had passed since he was conceived, his name was given to him: Jesus. This name was chosen by the angel before he was born in the womb.
verses.22: And when the days of their purification according to Moses’ law arrived, they brought him to Jerusalem to be presented before the Lord.
verses.23: As it is written in the law of the Lord: “Anything that is planted by a priest is considered holy.”
verses.24: And for offering sacrifices according to the law mentioned in the Lord’s commandment, it is necessary to have one or two sick sheep.
verses.25: And I saw that there was a man in the Temple named Simeon. This man was righteous and holy. He welcomed Israel’s return. And a holy spirit was upon him.
verses.26: And he was sanctified by the spirit of the holy one; he could not see death until he saw Christ, the Lord.
verses.27: And he came into the temple in that spirit. And when it was time to bring the parents before Jesus, who wanted to judge them according to the law that had been given about him,
verses.28: And he also carried it in his arms, and praised the god. He said:
verses.29: Now, you are releasing your slave, my lord, in peace and harmony.
verses.30: Because I saw in my eyes your salvation.
verses.31: Who has prepared everything according to the appearance of all nations.
verses.32: May there be revelation for the nations, and may your people, Israel, gain glory.
verses.33: And his father and mother also marveled at those who spoke about him.
verses.34: And Samuel praised them, and he said to their mother Mary: “Look, this man will bring about a great change in Israel, and he will serve as a sign for many people.”
verses.35: And your soul will also be freed from its imprisonment, so that it can be revealed through the thoughts and discussions of many hearts.
verses.36: And there was Hanna, a daughter of Phanuel, from the tribe of Asher. She lived for seven years after her marriage, living with her husband.
verses.37: And she was a widow until she reached the age of eighty-four. She never failed to attend the temple on nights and days when there were sacrifices and offerings to be made in her worship.
verses.38: And in that same year, it was accepted by God and became acceptable to all those who came to Jerusalem for worship.
verses.39: And after everything was done according to the laws of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own city of Nazareth.
verses.40: And the child was also nurtured and raised with wisdom; it was a gift from God.
verses.41: And his parents would go to Jerusalem every year during the Sabbath.
verses.42: And when they reached the age of twelve, they were allowed to go out in public according to the customs of their time.
verses.43: And after those days were over, while Jesus was being brought back to Jerusalem, his parents did not recognize him.
verses.44: They thought that he was among their companions. So, they went for days to find him among their relatives and acquaintances.
verses.45: And not finding him, they returned to Jerusalem in search of him.
verses.46: And after three days, he was found sitting in the temple, among the teachers. He was listening to them and also asking them questions.
verses.47: All those who heard him were impressed by his opinions and responses.
verses.48: And seeing him, they were shocked. His mother said to him, “Son, what have you done to us like this? Your father and I are too poor to pay you back.”
verses.49: And he said to them, “What do you want from me? Don’t you know that I am meant to be with my father?”
verses.50: And they did not agree with the words that he spoke to them.
verses.51: And he also went down with them, and arrived in Nazareth. He was under their care. And his mother kept all these words in her heart for two years.
verses.52: And Jesus was chosen by God and by men, based on his wisdom, age, and gifts.
